scope: Layered command scene, compact navigation, read-only clock/device HUD and explicit source drawers.

automated_checks.fixture_source: Production styles and view helpers; no workspace.js, live avatar renderer, owner endpoint or 3D engine loaded.
fixture_results: Saved palettes retained and unsaved startup dark
No page or navigation horizontal overflow; rightmost disclosure inside viewport
Desktop globe at least 570px and larger than previous styles
Telemetry stays inside reserved scene area; clock contrast checked
All primary phone targets at least 44px; actual brief/weather/device tools and pairing callback receive taps
Keyboard, native modal Escape, drawer focus and original source/nav/frame identity preserved
Actual companion button fills desktop and phone viewports, hides instruments and returns with Escape
No camera or microphone permission requested
automated_checks.test_scope_note: The final 39 unique broker checks include the focused command/theme/production-style checks. The earlier 13 and latest 16 combined results overlap with them; do not add these scopes. The 52 Studio appearance checks and 412 broker Python checks are separate suites.
automated_checks.root_wide_legacy_collection: Not claimed passed; previous unrelated brand/colour tests require separately absent Pillow.

data_and_permissions.clock: Actual browser local/date and UTC time; pauses when hidden, offscreen or companion; listener/timer cleanup tested.
data_and_permissions.devices: Supplied heartbeat records only; reporting first, then recent last report. All-record counts with a bounded visible list. A 180-second stale threshold prevents old online records appearing current.
data_and_permissions.hud_requests: No API, model or speech request from command-deck itself.
data_and_permissions.overview_refresh: Root integration uses existing authenticated device and system metadata reads while overview is active; no new mail or inference polling.
data_and_permissions.drawers: Daily brief/news, weather and saved device panels mount only on explicit open. Existing sources and timestamps remain in use.
data_and_permissions.permissions: No new grant, provider verification, camera, microphone, vehicle control or trading action.
data_and_permissions.startup_palette: Legacy implicit Sky migrates to Midnight; explicit saved palette choices remain selected. Theme is applied before the first stylesheet.

public_routes.provenance_note: The route artifact includes an earlier direct Node runtime run with 8 passes and 5 browser skips. The separate compatible Node/Chrome production-fixture run above executed all 13 checks.

viewport.kind: narrow desktop browser pane; not physical iPhone hardware

live_browser_acceptance.desktop_full_width_acceptance: Isolated production-CSS fixture matrix only; not a final full-width owner browser session.
